scope: Diagnostic synthetic dispatch, same FP16 GEMM; fixed-shape/precomputed controls are not general dynamic dispatch implementations. CPU/GPU profiler traces used for counts; timings taken without profiler.
wall_method: 7 randomized rounds x 100 fenced iterations, 50 interleaved warmups per variant
gpu_method: 31 randomized CUDA-event samples per variant, 2M-cycle sleep queued before start event to hide CPU enqueue gaps; excludes prefix and row compaction
